description:
Wayne was a secluded novelist who was obsessed with watching the young man who lived in the apartment across from him. His observation concluded that the man... could be a psychopathic serial killer. One day, Wayne went out of his house for the first time in many months. He runs into Oscar, who says he is a big fan...
